copy.headline: You may be interested in several possibilities while also feeling concerned by uncertainty.
copy.body: You report both interest in exploring possibilities and more stress-related reactions. In an uncertain situation, considering several explanations may accompany worry. The scores do not show how accurate those explanations are or what caused the strain.
copy.strength_sentence: Treat interest in complexity and attention to unease as starting points to check, not evidence of superior judgment or task suitability.
copy.risk_sentence: The price is this: when there is too much information, unclear boundaries, or too open choices, you may first be overwhelmed by the complexity itself.
copy.context_boundary: This pattern is clearest under uncertainty, ambiguous meaning, or information overload; it may soften when evidence and pace are clear.
copy.action_hook: Your priority is to separate complex issues into layers: which are real risks and which are just untested possibilities.
